restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r1-prefix-v1 only (one partial round plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

One attempt of the program (one random centre, DEG_CAP = 6); the claimed success probability 0.3934 is below the lower bound 0.3934647661 proved in proof.md section 8 (per-centre bound 0.3934678683, minus the cap-6 halt loss 3.1e-6, minus the root-isolation failure 2^-36); independent uniform random words are the model primitive (ideal randomness, proof.md D18).

heuristics.statement: The counts of proof.md sections 6 and 7 describe the executed program of proof.md section 10 under the stated rules: 1 per field operation, 1 per element load or store plus 1 address operation, 3 per loop iteration plus 2 per loop exit, 1 per other executed index or control operation, 237 per reduced permutation evaluation, and a 16-word register file per transform block as the only register assumption.
heuristics.scope: All stages of the program of proof.md section 4 at the target dimensions (m = 39062 for the main powering, N = 98304 and N' = 49152 in its transforms, 98304 evaluations of the line).
heuristics.extrapolation: None for the data-independent stages (they are executed totals). The data-dependent stages (half-gcd, root isolation) are charged at derived bounds that the program asserts against its own counters at every execution.
heuristics.limitations: The counts are produced by the instrumentation written into the source; the source is part of the proof text and was not run by the organizer. Word-level costs outside the stated rules (cache, bandwidth) are not part of the model.

heuristics.statement: In the worst-case bound of the root isolation, the charge of one level of degree d' <= d is at most 1.02 times the charge measured (Taylor shift, Z^((p-1)/2) mod G) or tabulated (gcd, division) at the largest degree d of that level; the kernel charges of the gcd bound are those of the executed kernels on operands of maximal lengths.
heuristics.scope: Stage E of proof.md section 6, levels d = 39062, 19531, ... , 4 (the factor 1.02 covers the parity effects of the recursion and the length of the exponent prefix).
heuristics.extrapolation: From the measured charge at each level's maximum degree to every smaller degree at that level.
heuristics.limitations: Not run for every degree. It affects only the charged time of a branch that needs a centre with a very large number of square roots, and not the success probability.
